item.description:
Dax 3.9.5

  • Fixes the “Invalid argument” error that could stop an upgrade while removing Dax’s previous background helper.
  • Opening the new Dax silently replaces verified older copies and continues into the app. No replacement screen, confirmation, completion button or separate uninstaller is needed. macOS may still request administrator approval for protected items.
  • Your projects, history, settings, saved secrets and coding-agent sessions are preserved. Replacement checks that cleanup finished before opening, and identifies the step if macOS prevents it from continuing.

On Dax 3.3 or earlier, or stuck during replacement? Install this release using the Dax installer.
